d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how President Bola Tinubu’s administration faces intense public scrutiny after signing a $700 billion minerals framework with the United States at the UN General Assembly. While Nigeria’s Minister of Solid Minerals, Dele Alake, pitches the deal as a transformative push toward local processing and job creation, domestic groups like the Arewa Consultative Forum (ACF) are demanding full disclosure.
